chunks: And in the narration of Hisham and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari:
A group of women entered upon Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, and one woman among them asked him about sihaq (tribadism).
So he said: "Its legal punishment is the legal punishment of the adulterer."
A woman said: "Allah has not mentioned that in the Qur'an." He said: "Yes, indeed."
She said: "Where is it?" He said: "They are the People of al-Rass."

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ: the People of al-Rass, a Qur'anic people referenced by the Imam
key_terms.السَّحْقِ: sihaq; tribadism or lesbian sexual conduct

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the punishment for sihaq and its connection to the People of al-Rass in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling on sihaq, stating that its hadd is the same as that of zina. It also presents the Imam’s identification of the People of al-Rass as a Qur'anic allusion connected to this matter, linking legal teaching with Qur'anic interpretation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5048 - In the narration of Hisham and Hafṣ ibn Al-Bukhturi, it is reported that a group of women entered upon Abu Abdullah (as), and one of the women asked him about lesbianism (Al-sahaq).
Imam (as) replied: "Its punishment is the same as that of the adulterer (Al-zani)."
A woman then said: "But Allah (swt) has not mentioned that in the Qur'an."
Imam (as) replied: "Indeed, He (swt) has."
She asked: "Where is it mentioned?"
Imam (as) said: "They are the people of Al-Rass (Ashab Al-Rass)."
